title: Separate personal records database from the Admin Panel

requirements.text: Create a separate backend storage boundary for “personal records” that is not shared with the Admin Panel’s record storage, and expose dedicated APIs for users to manage only their own personal records.

quotes: personal records database ko admin panal ke bahar rakho

acceptanceCriteria: Backend has two distinct record stores (e.g., admin-records vs personal-records) and they do not read/write the same underlying Map.
Personal-record APIs are scoped to the caller identity (Principal) so one user cannot list/read/update/delete another user’s records.
Personal-record APIs reject unauthenticated/unauthorized callers with clear errors (e.g., "Unauthorized").
Admin Panel APIs continue to exist and operate only on the admin record store (not personal-record store).

requirements.text: Update the frontend so the Admin Panel no longer displays or manages the personal records database; instead, implement a separate “Personal Records” experience outside the Admin Panel for signed-in users.

quotes: personal records database ko admin panal ke bahar rakho

acceptanceCriteria: Admin Panel UI only uses admin-only record queries/mutations and does not call personal-record APIs.
The non-admin area (Records view) provides a user-facing UI to view and manage the signed-in user’s personal records (list + detail + create/edit/delete) using the new personal-record APIs.
If the user is not signed in (Internet Identity), the Records view shows a clear sign-in prompt and does not show any records.

requirements.text: Add/adjust React Query hooks and mutations to support personal-record CRUD outside the Admin Panel, with correct cache keys and optimistic/refresh behavior similar to the existing admin-record flows.

quotes: personal records database ko admin panal ke bahar rakho

acceptanceCriteria: There are separate React Query cache keys for admin records and personal records (no shared cache keys).
Creating/updating a personal record immediately reflects in the personal records list and the selected detail view without requiring a manual reload.
Authorization errors for personal-record actions are handled gracefully in the UI (English messaging).

requirements.text: If the backend data schema changes in a way that would otherwise drop or orphan existing stored records, add a conditional Motoko migration to preserve existing data into the appropriate new store(s).

quotes: personal records database ko admin panal ke bahar rakho

acceptanceCriteria: Upgrade does not trap due to incompatible stable state changes.
Existing stored records (if any) are preserved after upgrade according to the new separation model, or explicitly moved into the intended store.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/immutablePaths (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui). Compose them instead.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo if required for state upgrade compatibility.
nonGoals: Implementing third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Introducing external databases or off-chain storage.
Implementing real-time sync (WebSockets) or push notifications.
